description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如  https:// devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrgId】
description.en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrgId】.
